main_text.p: יוֹנֵק m. Sugens, Lactens. יוֹנֶקֶת f. Ramus.
יָסַד Fundare. Pihel יִסַּד idem. Niphal נוֹסַד Fundari: item, Consultare. Pyhal יֻסַּד, Hophal הוּסַד Fundari.
מוֹסָדָה, מוֹסָד, f. יסודה, יסוד, יסוֹד f. Fundamentum. מוֹסָדִים, מוֹסָדוֹת Fundamenta.
יָסַף Hiphil הוֹסִיף Addere, Adjicere: Pergere. Niphal נוֹסַף Adjici, Addi. Chal. Praeter. Hophal הוֹסְפַּת Addita, Dan. 4.33.
יָסַר Castigare, Erudire. Pihel יִסֵּר idem. Niphal נוּסַר Castigari, Eruditi. Ex Hiphil Fut. אֵיסִירִם Castigabo eos, Hof.7.11. Hithpahel cum Niphal copositum, נִוָּסְרוּ Erudientur, Ezech 23.48.
יָעַד Condixit, Indixit, Constituit certum locum vel tempus: Desponsavit. Niphal נוֹעַד Convenire, Congregari ex condicto.

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation and some forms (e.g. Hophal and Niphal entries, the Hithpahel form) are small and partly blurred; read with doubt. The running head and catchword are as printed. Hebrew forms in the Niphal and Hophal entries may contain errors in the original print.
